text:
maria: Promotion blocked — staging smoke failing consistently on TestEmbeddingCacheConsistency (diff from last green after cache-change).
deploy-bot: Promotion paused for rollout #2026.03.21-57 — reason: 3 smoke failures in staging. Auto-retries exhausted.
ci-bot: Build 4821 logs: `ERROR: cache mismatch at step kv-prefix-apply` — tail: `AssertionError: expected 0x3f != 0x00` (attached: /artifacts/4821/logs)
ravi: Can we pin to the last-green image while we debug? Last green was image sha256:ef12a4b9 (2026-03-20 21:10 UTC).
ella: +1 for pin if we need the change window. We should also capture a failing core dump and test input before a rollback.
michael: What are the downsides of pinning vs rebuilding now? Pin keeps prod stable but delays the cache fix. Rebuild risks another flaky.
nicole: We're in the APAC change window in 90m. If we don't unblock, product team will ask for rollback decision. Ops-oncall, what impact to customers?
ops-oncall: No immediate customer-facing incidents, but some background jobs will see elevated latency for requests that hit the new cache path. Pining avoids broader rollout.
maria: Plan proposal: 1) manual promote pinned image sha256:ef12a4b9 to finish this promotion (safe path). 2) run a focused debug job on failing staging node: `kubectl exec -c runner staging-cache-debug -- cat /var/log/runner/cache-apply.log` 3) schedule full rebuild and canary tomorrow morning outside peak.
ravi: I can kick the manual promote. Command: ```/deploy promote --env=staging --image=sha256:ef12a4b9 --reason="pin-after-cache-flake"``` (ops approves?)
ops-oncall: Approve `:thumbsup:` — go ahead. Leave canary at 5% after promote for 30m.
ella: I'll attach the failing test input and run sanitized local repro. If we see deterministic fail, we'll propose a patch.
ci-bot: Started debug job 4822 (targeted run). Logs streaming: https://ci.internal/4822
maria: I'll update release notes: "Promotion delayed due to staging cache mismatch; pinned to last-green image. Debugging in progress; rebuild scheduled." Sending note to product channel after promote.
michael: If the debug shows non-deterministic kernel timing, we should add a short-term throttle on cache-write concurrency.
nicole: Please also capture cost/latency regression metrics for the pinned image so PMs have numbers.
ops-oncall: Manual promote issued by ravi at 1768904345. Deploybot: promotion succeeded to finish cut (canary 5% for 30m).
deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Reminder: follow up ticket (INF-7892) created for full rebuild + postmortem.
maria: Thanks folks. We'll reconvene in 45m or earlier if debug yields root cause. (cc @ravi @ella)
ravi: acknowledged. moving to unblock.
ella: uploading test artifacts now.
ci-bot: Debug job 4822 finished — reproducer obtained, failing on `kv-prefix-apply` in 3/3 attempts.
maria: OK — sticking with pinned image; schedule rebuild for 03/22 04:00 UTC. I'll file rollback notes and update the release doc.
ops-oncall: Noted. I'll monitor canary metrics and escalate if anything spikes.
michael: Filing an infra PR to add a temporary `cache_apply_max_concurrency=2` flag to limit blast radius (will link PR in INF-7892).
nicole: Thanks. Good call to pin. Keep PMs posted.
